artDirection.style: Use the already approved game references as the visual source of truth. Keep one coherent pixel-art / retro-game visual language across characters, props, icons and environments.
artDirection.characterConsistency: Hero, Player 2 and Lapka must preserve their approved identity/reference design across every state. Do not redesign faces, proportions or signature features between levels.
artDirection.textRule: Do not bake Russian UI copy into generated images unless the image is explicitly a document. Labels and copy remain HTML/CSS.
artDirection.framingRule: Keep transparent assets fully inside canvas with generous safe padding; no cropped limbs, ears, props or effects.
artDirection.mobileRule: Scene artwork must remain readable at narrow mobile widths. Avoid tiny essential details near image edges.
artDirection.runtimeFormat: PNG for alpha assets; WebP for opaque backgrounds.

v2AssetsStillNeeded.purpose: The existing manifest certificate key selects the retained PDF link; it is not an in-app graphic.

integrationRules.resolver: Map each image assetKey to runtimeFile. CSS entries must remain code-rendered and must not receive dummy image files.
integrationRules.fallback: Keep the current semantic placeholder fallback during integration until every image file in this manifest has loaded successfully.
integrationRules.noLogicChanges: Artwork integration must not change mechanics, progression, copy, localStorage, level ordering or post-game flow.
qa: No broken images or semantic placeholders in normal play.
Interactive hit areas remain DOM controls; artwork must not replace accessibility/click targets.
Certificate still links to the retained legacy PDF.
